entries.title: Crewmates gather by the computer they work on
entries.body: When your work runs on more than one computer, the crewmates around Firstmate gather in one group per computer, with the computer's name beneath its group. A computer that is out of reach keeps showing the crewmates it last had. The crewmates on this Mac look and move as before.

picture.alt: One Firstmate in the home cluster, with separate named crew clusters for two other work computers.
